title: pvAMRFragmentsFilter
body:
## pvAMRFragmentsFilter

One-step fragment analysis for non-overlapping AMR material data: it runs AMR connectivity (always resolving fragments across blocks), then fragment integration and optionally surface extraction, with one shared VolumeFractionValue. Output port 0 holds the fragment tables ("Fragment ID", "Fragment Volume", "Fragment Mass" and one "Volume Weighted <name>" or "Mass Weighted <name>" column per selected array) when IntegrateFragments is on; port 1 holds the fragment surfaces when ExtractSurface is on, made watertight by the AMR dual contour if UseWatertightSurface is set or by ExtractCTHPart otherwise. Select a port with {"node": id, "port": n}.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The shared VolumeFractionValue is used raw by the connectivity step but scaled by 255 by the contour step, so labels and surfaces can disagree slightly near the threshold.
- Give one mass array per material array, in the same order.
- With default settings port 1 is empty; enable ExtractSurface to get surfaces.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AMRFragmentsFilter`. Identity: `filters/AMRFragmentsFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the volume input of the filter. Accepted data: non-overlapping AMR data (vtkNonOverlappingAMR). The input needs at least one cell-centred array with 1 component. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkNonOverlappingAMR"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ExtractSurface` | Whether or not to extract a surface from this data | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `IntegrateFragments` | Whether or not to integrate fragments in this data | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `SelectMassArrays` | This property specifies the cell arrays from which the analysis will determine fragment mass | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SelectMassWeightedArrays` | This property specifies the cell arrays from which the analysis will determine mass weighted average values | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SelectMaterialArrays` | This property specifies the cell arrays from which the analysis will determine fragments | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SelectVolumeWeightedArrays` | This property specifies the cell arrays from which the analysis will determine volume weighted average values | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `UseWatertightSurface` | Whether the extracted surface should be watertight or not | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `VolumeFractionValue` | This property specifies the values at which to compute the isosurface. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
